tool_input.command:
R=/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec114/fx
python3 -B $R/plugins/dev-graph/scripts/resolve-repo-context.py --repo-root $R --mode read > $TMPDIR/rc.json; echo "rc_exit=$?"
python3 -c "
import json,os,sys
a=json.load(open('$TMPDIR/rc.json'));b=json.load(open('$R/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec/c24-receipt.json'))
for k in ['repo_root','repository_id','git_common_dir','git_dir','head_sha','worktree_id','branch']: print(k, a.get(k)==b.get(k), a.get(k))
print('content_roots eq', a['content_roots']==b['content_roots'])
print('root_trust', a.get('root_trust_evidence'))
ss=a['content_roots']['system_spec']; rp=os.path.realpath(ss)
print('ss realpath',rp, rp==ss, os.path.islink(ss))
print('repo realpath eq', os.path.realpath(a['repo_root'])==os.path.realpath(a['content_roots']['repository'])==a['repo_root'])
print('in repo', os.path.commonpath([rp,a['repo_root']])==a['repo_root'])
import hashlib
g=json.load(open('$R/eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-goal-spec.json'))
print('goal hash', hashlib.sha256(g['original_goal'].encode()).hexdigest()==g['original_goal_hash'])
"
echo ---; cd $R && python3 -B $R/plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-source-lineage.py --repo-root $R; echo "lin_exit=$?"
echo ---; find $R/system-spec -type l; ls -la $R/system-spec | head; git -C $R rev-parse --git-common-dir --show-toplevel
tool_input.description: Re-run resolve-repo-context and lineage gate, compare
